Attached are the redline notes (summary below). I kept things narrow to avoid blocking the procurement schedule:

Summary of proposed counters (high-level):
- Indemnity: retain mutual indemnity but cap at lesser of (i) fees paid in previous 12 months or (ii) $2M; add carve-out for IP infringement.
- Data retention: accept 180 days for operational trace logs; offer quarterly compliance report and an addendum for regulated customers that can extend retention under separate SOW.
- Subprocessors: require notice + 30-day cure window before onboarding a new subprocessor; include ability to request list annually.

I will not reopen the SLA uptime definitions — we can address escalations in the Order Form. Please confirm if Ben wants alternate commercial mitigations (short credit ladder vs. extended termination rights).

If everyone signs off, I'll generate a clean counter MSA for Mina to send to Avery by EOD.
